questions.prompt: Which service is planned for August 2027?
options: A new national mobile crèche network.
All the services for nine-month-old children.
questions.explanationZh: 2027年8月对应小学早餐俱乐部；课后与假期托育是2029年8月。

questions.prompt: Why does Early Years Scotland connect families with extra hours of care?
options: To help local schools start breakfast clubs.
To give providers funds for specialist equipment.
To fill gaps between or beyond existing arrangements.
To arrange new childcare services for island communities.
questions.explanationZh: 它针对既有安排之外或之间的服务空档，例如额外时段或衔接期。

questions.prompt: What distinguishes Inspiring Scotland’s support in this article?
options: It provides short-term help while longer-term care is arranged.
It supplies mobile crèches for parents on employment programmes.
It provides specialist childcare for children with complex disabilities.
It arranges flexible childminding placements with registered carers.
questions.explanationZh: 正文说明快速资金用于紧急情况或面试，同时落实较长期安排。

questions.prompt: How are the two kinds of support related?
options: Current grants fund an assessment before the wider plan is proposed.
The wider plan brings existing grant recipients into one provider network.
A common allowance replaces services responding to different family needs.
A staged plan sits alongside help for particular family needs.
questions.explanationZh: 文章结合分阶段的广泛服务计划与针对具体服务空缺的多样化支持。
